alt: Screenshot of Amazon Shopping app search bar showing AI-generated images of non-existent clothing products while the user types a search query
story: Amazon's Shopping app now generates AI images of clothes and furniture that don't exist while you type a search query, to 'help' you find real products on a site that already has millions of real product photos.
why_funny: The world's largest product catalog decided the best way to help shoppers find real things is to first show them fake things — for some reason.
